Description: This policy is designed for the FORTE Token

Rules.Name: TransferFromRule
Rules.Condition: ((((TR:addrTracker(senderX) == "T" OR TR:addrTracker(to) == "T") OR (TR:addrTracker(senderX) == "STK" AND (FC:isKYCd_to2 == true AND (TR:addrTracker(to) == "S" OR TR:addrTracker(to) == "E")))) OR (TR:addrTracker(senderX) == "M" AND (TR:addrTracker(to) == "S" OR TR:addrTracker(to) == "E"))) OR (TR:addrTracker(senderX) == "E" AND ((TR:addrTracker(to) == "E" OR TR:addrTracker(to) == "M") OR TR:addrTracker(to) == "S"))) OR (FC:isKYCd_from2 == true AND (TR:addrTracker(to) == "STK" AND ((TR:addrTracker(senderX) == "S" OR TR:addrTracker(senderX) == "E") OR TR:addrTracker(senderX) == "M")))
